messages:
maya: Noticing weird quotas on the console post-route-policy change 1: per-tenant request counts are inflated for some customers.

rick: any common factor? route, model, SDK version?

maya: quick grep shows most hits are from clients using ts-sdk v2.4-canary. the new header rename landed (X-RDWD-RTE -> X-Route) but proxy still reads the old header and re-inserts a normalized header, so server sees both. metrics pipeline aggregates by header and double-counts.

alina: ouch. do we have a repro?

maya: yes: run ts-sdk canary with proxy v1.8 and hit embeddings endpoint. curl sample:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer tok" -H "X-Route: fast-path" https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```
Proxy rewrites to `X-RDWD-RTE: fast-path` then our router emits both route tags downstream.

tom: that explains the per-route prometheus labels too. billing dedup happens later, but console per-route breakdown + heatmaps are wrong. customers will be confused.

jess: short-term: server ingestion should dedupe route headers by canonicalizing aliases (X-Route/X-RDWD-RTE). implement a strip proxy-inserted header if an upstream Route header is present. low-risk.

ci-bot: ci/tests: route-canonicalization-suite -> failing (1767779050) :x:

rick: tests failing because ts-sdk test harness still asserts single header. We need test update + fix.

alina: SDK side: ts-sdk change was meant to be non-breaking but we shipped a header rename without proxy handshake. we should revert the header rename in canary or ship a shim that sends both headers for a release to buy time.

maya: prefer shim (send both) for one release and update proxy quickly. users on older proxies won't break and newer proxies can start honoring new header.

jess: agreed. action items: 1) server dedupe patch (alina) 2) proxy will accept new header and stop injecting old alias (tom) 3) ts-sdk to emit both headers as shim (rick) 4) add console "route alias dedupe" flag to preview corrected metrics (maya).

ci-bot: deploy proxy-canary v1.8.1-rc -> started (1767779100)

rick: opened PR ts-sdk#7890 (emit both headers), want to keep it tiny and opt-in via env var TS_ROUTE_SHIM=enabled.

alina: server PR 455 (route canonicalization + tests) pushed. Hitting unit test flakiness, fixing expectations.

tom: proxy PR 322 to stop injecting when X-Route present; will roll to 10% of tenants first.

maya: console feature flag created: "dedupe route aliases". I added a tooltip and a note in the metrics tile that values are affected during rollout.

ci-bot: deploy proxy-canary v1.8.1-rc -> success (1767779150) :white_check_mark:

rick: pushed ts-sdk canary with shim env var. smoke tested locally; headers now look like:
```
X-Route: fast-path
X-RDWD-RTE: fast-path
```
Works with both proxy versions.

alina: merged server dedupe; ingestion now collapses alias headers to canonical route before metrics emit. will monitor console heatmaps.

maya: ops check scheduled @15:30 in #eng-platform to validate that the per-route spikes are gone. please post quick notes to the customer-facing doc if this affects any active canaries.

jess: we'll keep the ts-sdk shim for one minor release then remove it once proxies are fully on the new header. add to release notes and changelog.

maya: TL;DR: root cause = header rename + proxy aliasing => console double-route attribution. mitigation = server dedupe + ts-sdk shim + proxy opt-out of inject + console flag + staged rollout.

rick: assigning follow-ups: alina(server), tom(proxy), rick(ts-sdk), maya(console/docs). recon in 45m.

maya: thanks all. closing loop after post-rollout validation. :rocket:
